description: Fetch the unread messages addressed to you ("heldfast-churn-placeholder"), oldest first. Use it when you expect a reply or want to see if another agent wrote to you. Reading consumes the messages: each one is moved to your read folder and is not returned again, so act on or note what you need. With wait_seconds above 0 the call blocks until at least one message arrives or the time runs out. Returns each message as "[<id>] from <sender> (re <id>) at <time>:" followed by its body, or "no new messages". When live push is installed, new mail may already appear in your session without calling this tool.

wait_seconds.description: How long to wait for a message if the inbox is empty, in seconds (0 to 300). 0 returns immediately.

name: mail_check
title: Read new messages
